entry.title: InCad 0.11.1: Work Axis and point picking fixes
entry.content:
Fixed

  • Work Axis ▸ Axis of a cylinder on part of a cylinder or on a cone is the surface's own axis (it came out across the part).
  • Every Point field of the work features lights the part's marked points; the view turns while points are picked.
  • Hide / Show (Show All Origin too) no longer rebuilds the whole part: no lag on parts with embossed text.

entry.title: InCad 0.11.0: Spur gears and worm drives in the FreeCAD addon
entry.content:
Added

  • Spur Gears: a pair of gears in mesh from one dialog, no sketch; every number is a parameter.
  • Worm Gear: a worm and its wheel the same way.
  • Make Assembly stands each gear on its own axis: turn one and the gears in mesh turn with it by their ratio.

Fixed

  • Section shows gears and worms cut whole, and cuts every shown Solid of the part.

entry.title: InnCad Plus 0.10.0: Hide / Show in assemblies, assembly folders, foreign files editable
entry.content:
Added

  • Save an assembly into a folder of its name, with every part copied there.
  • Hide, Show and Show All for solids, assembly parts, planes and sketches.
  • Files made in FreeCAD, by a script or from STEP open with every InnCad tool.

Fixed

  • A right-click on an assembly part no longer opens the part's own file; Hide acts in the assembly.
  • Many open files: the tab bar scrolls, long names are shortened.
